review_scope: Independent final numeric/reliability audit of the actual Desktop PDFs; original manuscripts and recorded data unchanged. No server access, model generation, retraining, or credential collection.

source_correction_actual_execution.archive_layout: Files are at the ZIP root; no enclosing top-level folder. Extract into a new directory of any name and use that extraction directory as the working directory.
source_correction_actual_execution.numpy_use: The entrypoint imports NumPy at startup, before hash checks, and invokes audit_completed_experiment.py, whose fixed-output paired interval calculations use NumPy. Legacy replay/source correction stages also execute; no GPU/model/network dependency is required.
source_correction_actual_execution.execution_method: Extracted the original ZIP into a fresh TemporaryDirectory; invoked the entrypoint in that extraction directory. The entrypoint made its own temporary copy and temporary extraction of original_reviewer_replay.zip. Temporary folders were removed automatically; no original evidence file was altered.
source_correction_actual_execution.important_distinction: The old replay verifies frozen pre-correction scores. The source-correction layer reconstructs current manuscript correctness scores without changing model outputs, parsers, policies, or receipts.

specialist_actual_reconstruction.execution_method: Inspected independent JSON/binding/normalization/decision implementation; executed from its existing source in memory after an AST transform replaced its write_text expression with pass. Read all recorded completions/inputs; did not overwrite its original report.

independent_pool_reconstruction.method: Built union-find components over claim identities linked by any shared supplied doc_id; counted distinct documents and gold labels directly from frozen records.

bootstrap_protocols_from_archived_code.stage: Historical/primary paired comparisons and mathematical service/policy replay (S3/S5/S9)

bootstrap_protocols_from_archived_code.grouping: 63 source-document components; three adapter seeds retained together

task_native_time_distinction.interpretation: Summed generation excludes loading. Launch-to-completion wall time includes loading and orchestration; they are different measurements.
